I contacted Aqua Bella pools for an estimate or service. Over the next few months after service we talked about plans to renovate the pool and we started the project this spring. Abel communicated with me the entire way and the process was smooth, the crew was neat and everyone that came to my home was amazing and very collaborative and allowed me to ask questions. Thank you for an amazing experience and an amazing pool ! Stan Williams, Satisfied Customer Abel was absolutely incredible with my pool. I had a green pool with algae and other issues that i could not fix and Aqua Bella found the issue and corrected the problem. It was a broken manifold, DE in pool and debris on the bottom. Thanks for everything. Carlos M, Pool Customer This Pool Service is the best. Abel has taken care of our pool for 3 years,we never have to worry about cleaning it, putting chemicals in or havingto try to balance out chemicals, no maintenance – he does it all. He is dependable, trustworthy, thorough, and we get to enjoy fun times with family and making great memories. Donnie Wyatt Donnie Wyatt, Pool Owner Our Services Here is a list of available services for our customers. data.summary: The review profile is highly suspect. A perfect 5.0 rating with only 6 Google reviews, combined with a complete absence of reviews on all other major platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz, Trustpilot), strongly indicates the reviews are not a natural or authentic reflection of customer experience. The business exists online but has not accumulated organic feedback. This pattern is a significant red flag for review manipulation or a very new/unestablished business with minimal real customer interactions.
fake_signals: Perfect 5.0 rating with very low review count (6)
No reviews found on other major platforms despite business listings
Lack of any negative or neutral feedback
No detailed review content provided for authenticity analysis
Business appears on Yelp search results but has no reviews
authentic_signals: Business has a legitimate online presence across multiple directories
data.discrepancy_explanation: A perfect 5.0 Google rating with only 6 reviews is highly suspicious, especially when contrasted with a complete lack of reviews on other major platforms (Yelp, Angi, Houzz, Trustpilot) where the business is listed. The Glassdoor result shows only 1 review, indicating minimal employee feedback. This pattern suggests the Google reviews may be artificially inflated or solicited from a very narrow base.
